developer.name: Million
developer.title: Full-Stack Developer & Data Enthusiast
developer.bio: I'm a passionate full-stack developer with a deep interest in data visualization and meteorological data. This project combines my love for web development and weather data analysis, hoping to provide everyone with a simple and useful historical weather query tool.

project.title: About This Project
project.description1: This is a personal project for historical weather data queries, designed to help everyone easily view and compare weather conditions for the same date across different years.
project.description2: The project is built with modern web technologies and integrates open-source weather data APIs like Open-Meteo to provide free and accurate historical weather data services.
project.description3: Whether you want to know last year's weather for today or study historical temperature trends for a specific date, this tool can help you.

motivation.title: Why I Built This
motivation.description1: As someone interested in weather patterns, I often wonder "Was it this cold last year today?" or "What was the hottest temperature ever recorded on this date?" But I found it hard to find a simple, easy-to-use tool to query this information.
motivation.description2: So I decided to build one myself. I hope this little tool can help more curious people like me easily explore the mysteries of historical weather data.

dataSource.title: Data Sources
dataSource.description: This project uses open-source weather data APIs to ensure data accuracy and real-time updates. Thanks to these excellent open-source projects that allow us to access high-quality weather data for free.
dataSource.accuracy: Data Accuracy: Hourly level, temperature accurate to 0.1°C
